# Third-party copyright notices and licenses

This list follows normal dependencies from `cargo metadata --offline --filter-platform wasm32-unknown-unknown`. Procedural macros and build dependencies run on the host and are excluded. License texts are copied from crate distributions, with identical texts included once. The statically linked standard library and allocator are listed separately because they do not appear in the guest Cargo dependency tree.

| Crate | Version | License | Copyright notice and text |
|---|---|---|---|
| bitflags | 2.13.2 | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | [LICENSE-APACHE](#text-1), [LICENSE-MIT](#text-2) |
| block-buffer | 0.10.4 | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | [LICENSE-APACHE](#text-3), [LICENSE-MIT](#text-4) |
| cfg-if | 1.0.5 | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | [LICENSE-APACHE](#text-1), [LICENSE-MIT](#text-5) |
| crypto-common | 0.1.7 | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | [LICENSE-APACHE](#text-3), [LICENSE-MIT](#text-6) |
| digest | 0.10.7 | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | [LICENSE-APACHE](#text-3), [LICENSE-MIT](#text-7) |
| generic-array | 0.14.7 | `MIT` | [LICENSE](#text-8) |
| sha2 | 0.10.9 | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | [LICENSE-APACHE](#text-3), [LICENSE-MIT](#text-9) |
| typenum | 1.20.1 | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | [LICENSE](#text-10), [LICENSE-APACHE](#text-11), [LICENSE-MIT](#text-12) |
| wit-bindgen | 0.62.0 | `Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT` | [LICENSE-APACHE](#text-1), [LICENSE-Apache-2.0_WITH_LLVM-exception](#text-13), [LICENSE-MIT](#text-14) |
| Rust std, alloc, core | 1.98.1 (48a229ceaefd4985c50990b14116b6d856af0985) | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | [MIT](#rust-standard-library-mit), [Apache-2.0](#rust-standard-library-apache-20) |
| dlmalloc | 0.2.13 (Rust sysroot) | `MIT OR Apache-2.0` | [MIT](#dlmalloc-mit), [Apache-2.0](#dlmalloc-apache-20) |
| compiler_builtins | 0.1.160 (Rust sysroot) | `MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND (MIT OR Apache-2.0)` | [LICENSE.txt](#compiler-builtins-license) |

Release link maps from `cargo rustc --offline --locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -C link-arg=-Map=<map>` identify sysroot hashbrown in Regex and compiler_builtins functions in Regex and Json; Hash conservatively lists the sysroot compiler_builtins dependency even though its map has no surviving compiler_builtins functions.

The guest code is licensed under `MIT OR Apache-2.0`. Benitoite notices are included in [Text 15](#text-15), [Text 16](#text-16).

## Rust standard library notices

The Rust 1.98.1 distribution's `share/doc/rust/COPYRIGHT.html` identifies the in-tree copyright holder as “The Rust Project Developers (see https://thanks.rust-lang.org)”. The standard library Cargo manifests in rust-src specify `MIT OR Apache-2.0`. The rust-src component omits the root license files; the MIT text below comes from the same toolchain's `share/doc/clippy/LICENSE-MIT` (without its title) and matches [Rust's root LICENSE-MIT at this commit](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/blob/48a229ceaefd4985c50990b14116b6d856af0985/LICENSE-MIT). The Apache text comes from rust-src's `library/stdarch/LICENSE-APACHE`. The dlmalloc texts, including its copyright notice, come from `library/vendor/dlmalloc-0.2.13/` in rust-src.
